description: Land Acquisition - Demaladuwa, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2048/21 of 05.12.2017, Kesbewa D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents) for public purposes related to the expansion of Kesbewawewa. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisitions, property ownership details, and compensation claims for land being acquired by the government.
